description.value: Best Falafel is a family-owned Syrian-Lebanese fast food restaurant founded by Damascus-born Hisham Wattar, who has been feeding Vancouverites since 2000. The Kitsilano location sits on West 4th Avenue, a well-travelled cycling corridor, and serves wraps, plates, and falafel made from fresh ingredients rooted in Syrian and Lebanese tradition. With three Metro Vancouver locations and a robust catering operation, it has grown from a single Commercial Drive fixture into a recognizable local chain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies the West 4th Avenue (Kitsilano) location of Best Falafel. The website confirms the address (1859 West 4th Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6J 1M4) and provides the location's phone number (604-428-5522). The menu page confirms vegetarian and gluten-free items (Vegetarian Plate, Gluten Free Tabbouleh Salad, falafel items), and the restaurant's fast-food/takeout model is evident from the online ordering links and delivery messaging. No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
